title: config/fin-books-accepted.yml
description: City budget book readings a person reviewed and accepted (I-in, ADR 0011 decision 2a, row FB). The daily run keeps the stored finance.json when a new build reads worse (collector/fin_books.py worse_than_committed). An entry drops that one book's keep reasons only while the new build reads the listed source file (source_sha256) and the stored book's source differs from it, so it is spent once the next run writes the reading. Changed only by a person's reviewed pull request. Each (locality, book_id, source_sha256) appears at most once, and listed_on must be a real day (collector/reviewed_lists.py applies both). An empty list accepts nothing.

locality.description: The locality whose books these are (config/localities/<locality>/finance.yml).

book_id.description: The book's id in that finance.yml budget.books (finance.json books[].id).

source_sha256.description: The full sha256 of the new source file the reviewed reading came from (the new build's sources[].sha256 for that book): 64 lowercase hex.

listed_on.description: The day the entry was added (YYYY-MM-DD).

reason.description: What the person checked in the new reading (build/fin-books-<locality>.json), in plain words.
